modelSolLuna.aboutBody: GPT-6 Sol and Luna offer two complementary ways to build in Enter. Use Sol for thoughtful structure and detailed execution. Use Luna to explore directions quickly and refine ideas through iteration. Start with a clear prompt, then continue shaping the same project as your needs evolve.
modelSolLuna.useTitle: Build with GPT-6 Sol & Luna in Enter
modelSolLuna.useBody: Describe what you want to create, review the first result, and refine the layout, content, features, and interactions—all within the same project.
modelSolLuna.faqTitle: FAQs about GPT-6 Sol & Luna Prompts
modelSolLuna.faqBuildQuestion: What can I build with GPT-6 Sol and Luna prompts?
modelSolLuna.faqBuildAnswer: You can create websites, apps, dashboards, campaign experiences, productivity tools, and interactive concepts. Adapt each prompt to your audience, content, and visual direction.
modelSolLuna.faqUseQuestion: How do I use a Sol or Luna prompt in Enter?
modelSolLuna.faqUseAnswer: Open Enter and paste or write a prompt when starting a project. Review the result, then request specific changes to the layout, content, features, or interactions.
modelSolLuna.faqChooseQuestion: How should I choose between Sol and Luna?
modelSolLuna.faqChooseAnswer: Use Sol when your project benefits from deliberate structure and detailed execution. Use Luna when you want to explore ideas quickly and iterate through different directions.
modelSolLuna.faqEditQuestion: Can I edit these prompts before building?
modelSolLuna.faqEditAnswer: Yes. Replace the example audience, content, workflow, and design direction with your own requirements before opening the prompt in Enter.
modelSolLuna.faqIdeasQuestion: Where can I explore more app ideas?
modelSolLuna.faqIdeasAnswer: Visit Enter Library to browse curated projects, live previews, and reusable prompts.

modelAstra.aboutBody: From business dashboards and landing pages to 3D scenes and interactive tools, a clear prompt is a starting point for your next project in Enter. Adapt the details to your own goal and preserve the original context of multi-step instructions. Curated prompts and live examples will be added to this collection.
modelAstra.useBody: Start with an idea and describe what you want to build. Preview the result, explain the changes you want, and keep refining the same project before you publish or share it.
modelAstra.faqBuildQuestion: What can I build with GPT-6 Astra prompts?
modelAstra.faqBuildAnswer: Use prompts to describe websites, apps, dashboards, productivity tools, 3D scenes, and interactive experiences. Tailor the content, features, and visual style to your own project.
modelAstra.faqUseQuestion: How do I use a GPT-6 Astra prompt in Enter?
modelAstra.faqUseAnswer: Open Enter and describe your project or paste a prompt when starting a new project. Review the first result, then request changes to the layout, features, content, or interactions.
modelAstra.faqEditQuestion: Can I edit a prompt before building?
modelAstra.faqEditAnswer: Yes. Replace the example content with your own audience, workflow, brand, data, and design preferences. Specific requirements make the first result easier to evaluate.
modelAstra.faqSourcesQuestion: How will prompts in this collection be sourced?
modelAstra.faqSourcesAnswer: Hot Cases are published Enter projects. Some case prompts are catalog-based reconstructions and are labeled as such. Trending Prompts will include the original creator and source when available.
modelAstra.faqIdeasQuestion: Where can I explore more app ideas?
modelAstra.faqIdeasAnswer: Visit Enter Library for curated cases, live previews, and reusable prompts. You can also describe your own idea on the Enter homepage.
